name: Gustave
joins: Start - playable from the opening expedition
summary: Gustave is the character the game starts on. Act 1 follows him as he assembles his expedition team and crosses The Continent toward the Paintress.
background: In the prologue he says goodbye to his former partner Sophie on the day she is Gomaged - along with every other 33-year-old in Lumiere. That loss is what sets his expedition in motion. See the Gommage day section of world lore.

relationships.label: Verso
relationships.with: Share the same weapon set - every Gustave Lumina is listed as Gustave / Verso

appearances: Playable from the start of the game
Act 1 is framed around him - see the walkthrough
His weapons are catalogued on all weapons

name: Lune
summary: Lune is the party's healer and its elemental setup. She applies Burn and other elemental Stains that other characters then build their damage around.

relationships.label: Maelle
relationships.with: Her Burn setup is the trigger for Maelle's Rain of Fire - the pair is called the strongest early-game synergy

appearances: Playable from the start of the game
The Act 1 Demineur quest rewards her the Deminerim weapon
Full kit on the Lune build guide

name: Maelle
summary: Maelle joins during Act 1 at Flying Waters and is the fastest melee fighter in the party. Her Battle Stance system rewards constant switching: every stance change gives her +1 AP, so transitions are never wasted.
background: Maelle is really Alicia Dessendre, Verso's sister. Entering the Canvas overwhelmed her and she was reborn inside it as Maelle, without her memories. Act 3 centres on her, and the single decision that determines which ending you get is a private conversation with her - telling her the truth, or lying. Full breakdown on endings explained.

relationships.label: Verso
relationships.with: Brother - though the Verso in your party is a painted copy, not the original

relationships.label: Clea
relationships.with: Sister; the Nevrons call her Mistress because of the family link

relationships.label: Renoir
relationships.with: The painted Renoir is the antagonist for most of the game; the real one causes the Gommage

appearances: Joins during Act 1 at Flying Waters
Act 3 is built around her
A required conversation with her in Act 3 gates the endings
Full kit on the Maelle build guide

name: Sciel
summary: Sciel joins at Gestral Village and is the party's area-damage dealer. She is at her strongest once she reaches Twilight, which her Foretell stacking builds toward.

relationships.label: Maelle
relationships.with: Can generate additional AP, which keeps Maelle in Virtuose Stance longer

appearances: Joins mid-game at Gestral Village
Her weapons are listed on all weapons

name: Verso
summary: Verso joins in Act 2 at the Sinister Cave and shifts the party's damage model toward marks. His Perfection Rank climbs from D to S as he fights, and Marking Shot sets up mark-dependent skills on allies.
background: The Verso you recruit is a painted copy of the real Verso Dessendre, who died in a fire at the family home. The Canvas itself was painted into existence by that real Verso, and holds the last surviving fragment of his soul. See world lore.

relationships.label: Maelle
relationships.with: His sister - she is Alicia Dessendre, reborn inside the Canvas without her memories

relationships.label: Monoco
relationships.with: The painted Verso created the Gestrals, and Monoco was based on his real-world dog

appearances: Joins in Act 2 at Sinister Cave
Shares his weapon set with Gustave
Full kit on the Verso build guide

name: Monoco
joins: Late Act 2 - after being fought as a story boss
summary: Monoco is the most flexible party member and the least specialised. He is fought as a story boss alongside Stalact before he can be recruited, and his value is AP generation for the whole party rather than personal damage.
background: Monoco is a Gestral. The Gestrals were created by the painted Verso, and Monoco specifically was modelled on his real-world dog.

relationships.label: Verso
relationships.with: Created the Gestrals; Monoco was based on his dog

appearances: Fought as a story boss in Act 2 with Stalact
Joins late in Act 2
His weapon set is the Gestral-themed one listed on all weapons

name: Esquie
summary: Esquie is not a party member but a mount whose abilities gate areas of the map: Swim crosses water, Dive opens underwater routes, Climb reaches high ground, and Fly unlocks late-game.
appearances: Unlocked through the story rather than recruited
Francois is fought at Esquie's Nest during Act 1, after Flying Waters
Several optional areas only open once Esquie can swim or fly - see bosses by area
Collect Esquie's missing rocks scattered across the map
description: Esquie in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - the mythical mount whose Swim, Dive, Climb and Fly abilities gate areas of the map, and how to unlock each.
